verses.text: Then all Israel—from Dan to Beersheba and across Gilead—gathered together as one at Mizpah before Yahweh. 🤝
The leaders of all the tribes took their places in God’s people’s assembly. Four hundred thousand foot soldiers, all carrying swords, showed up. ⚔️
Benjamin’s people heard Israel had gathered at Mizpah. Israel asked, ‘Tell us, how did this evil happen?’ 🗣️
The Levite, the murdered woman’s husband, answered, ‘My concubine and I came to Gibeah in Benjamin’s territory to spend the night. 📜
‘Gibeah’s men surrounded the house in the night, planning to kill me. They raped my concubine, and she died. 💔
‘I took her body, cut it into pieces, and sent them throughout Israel’s territory, because Gibeah’s men did a vile, outrageous thing in Israel. ⚠️
‘Now, all you Israelites, tell us what you think we should do.’ 📣
All the people stood up together and said, ‘None of us is going back to our tent or home. 🤝
‘Here’s what we’ll do to Gibeah: we’ll draw lots to choose who goes up against it. 🎲

‘We’ll take ten men out of every hundred, a hundred out of every thousand, and a thousand out of every ten thousand to gather supplies for the army—so we can deal with Gibeah for the outrage they committed in Israel.’ 📦
So all Israel’s men gathered against the city, united as one. 🛡️
Israel’s tribes sent messengers throughout Benjamin, saying, ‘What kind of evil happened among you? 📨
‘Hand over those wicked men in Gibeah so we can put them to death and remove this evil from Israel.’ But Benjamin wouldn’t listen to their fellow Israelites. ⚖️
Instead, Benjamin’s people gathered from their towns at Gibeah to fight Israel. ⚔️
That day Benjamin counted 26,000 sword-carrying men from its towns, besides 700 chosen men from Gibeah. 🔢
Among them were 700 left-handed fighters. Every one could sling a stone at a hair and hit the mark. 🎯
Israel’s men, not counting Benjamin, numbered 400,000 sword-carrying fighters. ⚔️
Israel got up, went to Bethel, and asked God, ‘Who should lead us into battle against Benjamin?’ Yahweh answered, ‘Judah goes first.’ 🙏
Israel got up in the morning and camped against Gibeah. 🌅
Israel’s men went out to fight Benjamin and lined up for battle at Gibeah. 🛡️
Benjamin’s men came out of Gibeah and struck down 22,000 Israelite soldiers that day. ⚔️
Israel’s people encouraged each other and lined up for battle again where they had stood the first day. 💪
Israel went up and wept before Yahweh until evening. They asked, ‘Should we go fight our brother Benjamin again?’ Yahweh said, ‘Go against him.’ 😢
So Israel came forward to fight Benjamin on the second day. ⚔️
Benjamin came out from Gibeah to meet them and struck down another 18,000 Israelite soldiers, all carrying swords. ⚔️
Then all Israel and the rest of the people went up to Bethel. They wept and sat before Yahweh, fasting until evening. They offered burnt offerings and peace offerings to Yahweh. 🙏
They asked Yahweh for guidance. The ark of God’s covenant was there then, 🕊️
and Phinehas son of Eleazar, grandson of Aaron, served before it. They asked, ‘Should we go fight our brother Benjamin again, or stop?’ Yahweh said, ‘Go. Tomorrow I’ll hand him over to you.’ 🙏
Israel placed ambush teams all around Gibeah. 🥷
On the third day, Israel went up against Benjamin and lined up against Gibeah as before. ⚔️
Benjamin came out to fight and pulled away from the city. They began striking Israel’s men as before, killing about thirty along the roads to Bethel and Gibeah, and in the fields. 🛣️
Benjamin’s people said, ‘We’re beating them like the first time!’ But Israel’s men had agreed, ‘Let’s retreat and draw them away from the city onto the roads.’ 🏃
All Israel’s men moved from their positions and lined up at Baal-Tamar. Then Israel’s ambush group burst out from its hiding place west of Geba. 🥷
Ten thousand chosen Israelite fighters came up against Gibeah. The battle was fierce, and Benjamin didn’t know disaster was right around the corner. ⚔️
Yahweh defeated Benjamin before Israel. That day Israel struck down 25,100 sword-carrying Benjamites. ⚖️
Benjamin realized it was losing. Israel’s men had pulled back because they trusted the ambush they’d set near Gibeah. 🧭
The ambushers hurried and rushed into Gibeah, spread through the city, and struck everyone there with swords. ⚔️
Israel’s men and the ambushers had agreed on a signal: a huge cloud of smoke would rise from the city. 🌫️
Israel’s men turned back into the fight. Benjamin started killing about thirty of them, thinking, ‘They’re going down just like in the first battle.’ ⚔️
But then a column of smoke started rising from the city. The Benjamites looked back and saw the whole city burning up toward the sky. 🔥
Israel’s men turned around, and Benjamin’s men panicked when they realized disaster had caught up with them. 😨
They turned and fled toward the wilderness, but Israel’s fighters kept chasing them. Those who came out of the towns cut them down along the way. 🏃
Israel surrounded the Benjamites, chased them down, and ran them over as far as the area east of Gibeah. ⚔️
Eighteen thousand Benjamites fell there—all experienced fighters. ⚔️
The rest turned and fled toward the wilderness, to Rimmon Rock. Israel killed five thousand along the roads and kept chasing them to Gidom, striking down another two thousand. 🏃
That day, 25,000 Benjamite sword-carrying fighters fell. They were all experienced warriors. ⚔️
But six hundred men escaped into the wilderness to Rimmon Rock and stayed there four months. 🪨
Then Israel’s men went back and struck Benjamin’s towns with swords—the people, the livestock, and everything they found. They set every town they came across on fire. 🔥
